title: A Bridge of Grass

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: A heavy day: the Iran war spreading through the Gulf and Yemen, factories burning in Odesa, hunger in Gaza, a sunken boat off Gambia and floods near Istanbul. Small lights: a Tigray interim government, solar for Lebanon, and a wildlife bridge that works.

lines: Rain came down like eighty years at once,
the streets near Istanbul ran brown.
In Odesa the factories burned till dawn,
in Gaza there was nothing left to hand round.
A boat went under off the Gambian coast,
twelve names the tide won't give us back.
Kenya counts a third one in a quiet ward,
the Gulf lights up along the same old track.
But the deer cross over on a bridge of grass,
nine in ten make it home —
someone's teaching the plastic to go.
